title: Quick-Start Protocol for DNeasy Blood & Tissue Kit and Genotyping
author: Janna Jernigan Posey
materials: Optional: Repeat step 7 for increased DNA yield.
Determine the concentration of DNA using the denovix.
DNA can be stored in -20°C until genotyping.

steps.title: Prepare Sample Lysate
steps.instruction: Prepare the sample based on the material type using a 1.5 ml or 2 ml microcentrifuge tube.

substeps.instruction: For Tissue: Cut tissue (≤10 mg spleen or ≤25 mg other tissue) into small pieces (or use 1 rat or 2 mouse 0.4–0.6 cm tail lengths), add 180 µl Buffer ATL and 20 µl proteinase K. Vortex and incubate at 56°C until completely lysed, vortexing occasionally. Vortex for 15 s before proceeding.
For Nonnucleated blood: Add 20 µl proteinase K and 50–100 µl anticoagulant-treated blood. Adjust volume to 220 µl with PBS.
For Nucleated blood: Add 20 µl proteinase K and 5–10 µl anticoagulant-treated blood. Adjust volume to 220 µl with PBS.
For Cultured cells: Centrifuge a maximum of 5 x 10^6 cells for 5 min at 300 x g (190 rpm), resuspend in 200 µl PBS, and add 20 µl proteinase K.

steps.title: Lysis and Binding
steps.instruction: Perform lysis and prepare the DNA for column binding.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 µl Buffer AL and mix thoroughly by vortexing.
Incubate blood samples at 56°C for 10 min.
Add 200 µl ethanol (96–100%) and mix thoroughly by vortexing.

steps.title: DNA Purification
steps.instruction: Purify DNA using the DNeasy Mini spin column.

substeps.instruction: Pipet the mixture into a DNeasy Mini spin column in a 2 ml collection tube. Centrifuge at ≥6000 x g (8000 rpm) for 1 min. Discard flow-through and collection tube.
Place column in a new 2 ml collection tube, add 500 µl Buffer AW1, and centrifuge for 1 min at ≥6000 x g. Discard flow-through and collection tube.
Place column in a new 2 ml collection tube, add 500 µl Buffer AW2, and centrifuge for 3 min at 20,000 x g (14,000 rpm). Discard flow-through and collection tube.
Transfer the spin column to a new 1.5 ml or 2 ml microcentrifuge tube.
Add 200 µl Buffer AE to the center of the spin column membrane.
Incubate for 1 min at room temperature (15–25°C).
Centrifuge for 1 min at ≥6000 x g.

steps.title: Sample Preparation for Genotyping
steps.instruction: Prepare DNA samples and controls for the PCR reaction.

substeps.instruction: Obtain DNA samples and Known Allele control samples (e.g., Homozygous AA, Homozygous GG, and Heterozygous AG).
Dilute DNA sample to 25ng/reaction using nuclease free water to a final volume of 9ul (Note: starting concentrations may be tested at 12.5ng, 25ng, or 50ng/reaction).

steps.title: Prepare Taqman Master Mix
steps.instruction: Combine reagents to create the Taqman master mix (MM).

substeps.instruction: Combine 0.5ul/sample of 40X primer and taqman probe, 0.5ul/sample of 1XTE Buffer, and 10ul/sample of Taqman Universal PCR MM (specific to the target SNP).
Prepare enough MM for all samples plus a few extra.

steps.title: Plate Loading and Sealing
steps.instruction: Combine samples with master mix and load into the reaction plate.

substeps.instruction: Add 11ul of Taqman master mix to each diluted DNA sample.
Mix and reverse pipette samples + master mix into a 384 well plate in triplicate.
Seal the plate with Optical Adhesive Film.
Centrifuge the plate at 3000rpm for 5 min at 4°C.

steps.title: Genotyping Run
steps.instruction: Run the genotyping program on the Quant Studio v5.

substeps.instruction: Immediately transfer the plate to the Quant Studio v5.
Execute the program: 1) Pre-read fluorescence levels; 2) 10 minutes at 95°C; 3) 40 cycles of 92°C for 15 seconds followed by 60°C for 1 minute; 4) Post-read fluorescence levels.
